subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: My body
source.subtopic: Different parts of my body and how it moves

show.line: My body can bend, stretch, twist and jump. Elbows, knees and wrists help!

rounds.prompt: Which part bends in the middle of your leg?
Which part bends in the middle of your arm?
Your neck helps you turn your...?
Show me a way to move. Tell me what you did.

hints: Elbow and wrist are on your arm.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! This bends my arm.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The elbow bends my arm.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Elbows bend arms. Knees bend legs!

parent_line: Can name body parts and joints and how the body moves.
